# scripts/AISystem/Talk/TalkScript.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../../scripts/AISystem/Talk/TalkScript.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Parses data/talk/*.talk into {conversations, cast, errors} dictionaries.
Conversation blocks define conditions, parts, place, cooldown and ordered turns;
turn choices carry text/emotes/conditions/source. Adjacent conditional lines by
one part form alternatives. Library loading validates terms and closes mutual ties.
Errors include file:line; malformed input can still return partially parsed data.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

### terms

```gdscript
static func terms(text: String) -> Array
```

[Source:207](../../../../../../scripts/AISystem/Talk/TalkScript.gd#L207)

Terms joined by commas, each of alternatives joined by |: "a, b|c" is
[["a"], ["b", "c"]]. A bare word after "key:value" takes the key:
"night:early|middle" is ["night:early", "night:middle"].

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String` | required |

Return type: `Array`.
